Team Spirit is a Russian esports organization founded in 2015. The organization has been based in Belgrade, Serbia since 2022. [1]

  • June 9th - Team Spirit sign Team Phenomenon - COLDY, S0tF1k, DavCost, kibaken and Dima join, with Certus serving as the coach. [2]
  • March 30th - kibaken leaves Team Spirit. [3]
  • May 10th - starix joins Team Spirit. [4]
  • October 4th - starix steps down from Team Spirit. [5]
  • October 23rd - arch is signed by Team Spirit after a stand-in period. [6]
  • January 8th - somedieyoung replaces arch. [7]
  • February 5th - Team Spirit release starix. [8]
  • February 26th - Team Spirit part ways with DavCost and Dima. [9]
  • March 3rd - Team Spirit sign chopper and iDISBALANCE. [10]
  • September 26th - Team Spirit part ways with COLDYY1 and S0tF1k; they also acquire mir from Gambit Esports and add magixx from ESPADA. [11][12][13]
  • January 21st - Team Spirit place iDISBALANCE on the transfer list and acquire degster and Patsi on loan from ESPADA. [14]
  • March 21st - Team Spirit sign S0tF1k as an assistant coach. [15]
  • March 28th - Patsi is transferred to Team Spirit Academy. [16]
  • April 2nd - iDISBALANCE is acquired by Nemiga Gaming. [17]
  • July 24th - S0tF1k and hally from Team Spirit Academy switch positions on their respective teams. [18]
  • November 4th - Team Spirit bench and transfer-list chopper and mir. [19]
  • November 12th - Team Spirit bench and transfer-list sdy. [20]
  • January 13th - sdy is acquired by MAD Lions. [21]
  • February 6th - Team Spirit promote Patsi and s1ren from Team Spirit Academy and reinstate chopper to the starting lineup. Additionally, hally replaces Certus as head coach. [22]
  • June 8th - mir is acquired by Entropiq. [23]
  • June 11th - Team Spirit bench and transfer-list degster. [24]
  • June 21st - Team Spirit sign w0nderful. [25]
  • July 15th - degster is acquired by OG. [26]
  • January 1st - Team Spirit sign vboff as an analyst. [27]
  • February 9th - Team Spirit part ways with vboff. [28]
  • February 11th - Team Spirit sign clife as an analyst. [29]
  • June 22nd - Team Spirit bench s1ren and w0nderful. Additionally, Patsi is acquired by Team Liquid. [30][31]
  • July 5th - Team Spirit promote zont1x, ArtFr0st, and donk from Team Spirit Academy. [32]
  • July 10th - w0nderful is acquired by Sprout. [33]
  • July 31st - s1ren is acquired by BetBoom Team. [34]
  • December 17th - Team Spirit bench ArtFr0st and acquire sh1ro from Cloud9. [35]
  • January 7th - ArtFr0st is acquired by PARIVISION. [36]
  • December 15th - Team Spirit win the Perfect World Major in Shanghai, defeating FaZe Clan 2-1 in the grand final.
  • July 7th - Team Spirit bench magixx and acquire zweih from Nemiga Gaming. [37][38]
  • September 8th - Team Spirit bench zont1x and acquire tN1R from HEROIC. [39][40]
  • December 18th - Team Spirit bench chopper and zweih and reinstate magixx and zont1x to the starting lineup. [41]
  • December 30th - zweih is acquired by PARIVISION. [42]
  • June 4th - Team Spirit promote S0tF1k from the academy team as an assistant coach. [43]
